# Mission StayFit

> Fitness studio in CIDCO N4, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad), Maharashtra, India. Small-group Yoga, Tabata HIIT and Zumba batches for all ages and fitness levels.

## Classes and batch timings
- Yoga & Breathwork: Mon–Sat, 6:00–7:00 AM. All levels.
- Tabata HIIT: Mon–Sat, 7:15–8:15 AM. Intermediate to advanced.
- Zumba Dance Fitness: Mon–Sat, 5:30–6:30 PM. All levels.
- Navratri Garba Workshop: 28 Sept – 10 Oct, hourly batches 11 AM–1 PM and 4–7 PM. ₹800 per person, ₹600 per person for a group of 5.

## Studio details
- Address: Beside Balaji Towers, near old Gokul Sweets, N4, CIDCO, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra 431003
- Hours: Mon–Sat 6:00 AM – 9:00 PM, Sun 7:00 AM – 1:00 PM
- Phone: +91 82085 36490, +91 83292 83681
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/missionstayfit/
